svg.title: m-01 Menu and item details (Customer Mobile App)
svg.desc: Two low-fidelity phone frames for Café Mohnblume with the allergen filter set to H: A the business page with category chips, filter chip and banner, menu rows with VAT-inclusive prices and allergen letters, a dimmed item, a sold-out item and the cart bar; B the item details sheet for Linsen-Bowl with allergens above the options, choice letters and the running total. Numbered callouts 1 to 14.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Filter: ohne H · Angaben des Betriebs.
Linsen, Ofengemüse mit Sellerie, Kräuter, Zitrone
